page.overview:
Who is Polar Bear?

Peaceful: (still performs attack animation) Easy: Normal: Hard: Baby: Java Edition: against foxes only Bedrock Edition:

Baby:Height: 0.7 BlocksWidth: 0.7 Blocks

Polar bears are neutral mobs that live in icy cold biomes.

Polar bears spawn above grass or ice in snowy plains, ice spikes, regular and deep frozen ocean biomes in groups of up to two at light level 7 or higher. If there is a group, the second polar bear is a cub.
